title: Fran
creator: CrossFit
description: 21-15-9 reps of thrusters at 95/65 lb and pull-ups. Posted in August 2003, Fran is the most famous CrossFit benchmark: short, brutal and a test of how long you can keep moving under a burning heart rate. Elite times are under two minutes; scale with a lighter bar and ring rows or 12-9-6 pull-ups.
